messages:
elin: Pushed a tiny prototype tweak for Prompt Sets > Eval Runs: collapse row meta into a compact header and surface a per-row "score chip" + a persistent toolbar Approve action. Need quick UX/a11y pass before dev. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz
mike: Looks promising. Microcopy: prefer toolbar label 'Approve selected' and tooltip 'Approve selected eval runs (locks scorecards)'. Avoid 'bulk'.
hana: Accessibility: ensure the score chip has hidden text 'Quality score: 88' for screen readers and use >=4.5:1 contrast for the chip text.
taylor: Visual nit: in compact rows the chevron is cramped. Increase hit target to 40px and add aria-label 'Toggle diff preview'. Also add visible focus outline on the approve button for high-contrast theme.
a11y-bot: a11y notes: announce selection counts with aria-live polite like '3 runs selected'. When modal confirms approval, include aria-describedby linking to consequence text 'Only project admins can unapprove; see docs'. Keyboard: ensure Shift+A is not used elsewhere before assigning select-all; scope shortcuts to list focus.
elin: Good catches  I'll: change copy to 'Approve selected', add SR text for score chips, bump chevrons, add focus styles, and update modal copy to 'Approve 3 runs? This will lock these scorecards. Only project admins can unapprove.'
mike: Also add undo toast 'Approved 3 runs. [Undo] [Open change log]' with 10s undo. CTA text 'Open change log' feels clearer than 'View changes'.
hana: One more: keyboard-only flow test needed. I'll run and paste steps + screenreader sample narration here for handoff.
elin: Thanks! Will iterate and upload updated figma by EOD. :thumbsup:
